components.name: City Search

components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 8px; } .ds-input { min-width: 0; font: 16px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; padding: 10px 12px; background: #fff; color: #111827; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #2563eb; } .ds-search-btn { font: 16px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background: #2563eb; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2563eb; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(37,99,235,.16); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-btn:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-search-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-msg { margin: 8px 0 0; font: 500 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #374151; }

components.name: Twin Dials
components.description: The signature pair: two equal readings split by one hairline.
components.html:
65°F
Feels like 62°F
18°C
Feels like 17°C
components.css: .ds-dials { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #111827; transition: opacity .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-dials[aria-busy='true'] { opacity: .45; } .ds-dial { text-align: center; padding: 8px 8px 12px; min-width: 0; } .ds-dial + .ds-dial { border-left: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-reading { font-size: clamp(64px, 17vw, 120px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-unit { font-size: .34em; font-weight: 600; color: #6b7280; letter-spacing: 0; vertical-align: top; position: relative; top: .3em; margin-left: .08em; } .ds-feels { color: #6b7280; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The page is the two readings. °F and °C sit side by side at display size, split by a single hairline, like two faces of one instrument. Everything else is in service of those two numbers and stays quiet: a small title row naming the place, one muted line of conditions, and a single text control to change the city.

The feel is friendly and light. One white card floats on a soft gray field, corners are gently rounded, and a single weather emoji gives the page its warmth. Type is the visitor's own system font, so the page feels native on every device. Density is low: one card, one glance.

Signal Blue is the one voice of action. It marks what can be pressed and where keyboard focus is, and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Two equal readings at display size, divided by one vertical hairline; neither unit leads.
No boxes inside the card: separation comes from space and hairlines.
A single centered white card on a pale gray gradient field.
System font stack throughout; tabular figures on every number.
One accent color, reserved for interaction.
Emoji as the only iconography, hidden from screen readers.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue appears only on things you can press and on focus. Text, numbers, borders and decoration never use it.

rules.name: The Readings Are Loudest Rule
rules.body: Only the two temperatures use the Display sizes. Nothing else on the card competes with them, in size or in color.

rules.name: The Equal Pair Rule
rules.body: Both readings always share one size step. If one switches to Display Compact, both do.

rules.name: The Side-by-Side Rule
rules.body: The °F and °C readings always share a row at equal width. They never stack, and they never resize independently.

rules.name: The Reading Stays Rule
rules.body: Once a reading is on screen, it stays there. Updates dim it; failures add a notice beneath it. Only the first load shows a placeholder in its place.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the card casts a shadow, and nothing inside it is boxed.

dos: Do keep °F and °C at the same size step, weight and color.
Do use tabular figures for every number.
Do keep the last reading on screen through updates and failed searches.
Do reserve Signal Blue (#2563eb) for pressable things and focus, per the One Signal Rule.
Do show focus with the 2px solid Signal Blue outline, offset 2px.
Do put feedback next to the thing it is about: search messages under the field, update failures under the readings.
donts: Don't make one unit primary: no toggle, and no larger or brighter reading for either unit.
Don't box anything inside the card: no tinted panels, dashed outlines or nested shadows.
Don't use the Display sizes for anything except the two readings.
Don't add a Refresh button; the page refreshes itself when you come back to it.
Don't introduce a second accent color for decoration.
